description.value: Serious Coffee is a BC-born coffee chain founded in Duncan in 1994, now operating 16 locations across Vancouver Island, Powell River, and New Westminster. The café is known for a unique air-roasting process applied to premium Arabica beans sourced from Mexico, Kenya, Colombia, and beyond, producing a smooth, low-bitterness cup. Alongside espresso drinks and specialty teas, the chain runs its own bakery offering fresh muffins, scones, and breakfast wraps.
